description: This file defines a React functional component named SidebarFilters, which provides filtering UI elements (search input, status dropdown, tag dropdown) for a content management dashboard. It manages internal state for filter criteria and triggers an onChange callback when filters are updated. The component uses external theme definitions for styling.

methods.name: SidebarFilters
methods.description: React functional component that renders filtering controls for posts, managing internal state and calling onChange callback when filters change.
